scripts.dev: npm run build -w @routepulse/shared && concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @routepulse/api" "npm run dev -w @routepulse/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @routepulse/shared && npm run build -w @routepulse/api && npm run build -w @routepulse/web
scripts.test: npm run build -w @routepulse/shared && npm run test -w @routepulse/api && npm run test -w @routepulse/web
scripts.lint: npm run build -w @routepulse/shared && npm run lint -w @routepulse/api && npm run lint -w @routepulse/web
scripts.ci: npm run lint && npm test && npm run build
